name: Marriage Reconciliation
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divinely ordained union designed for companionship and unity, as God created a suitable helper for man and established that a husband and wife become one flesh. The blessings of marriage are affirmed through the value of a virtuous wife and the favor of the Lord upon those who find a wife. God’s intent for marriage is permanence, warning against divorce except in the case of fornication, and emphasizing that what God has joined together should not be separated by man.
